spine: 1. LinkedIn 的 code review 系統不是單一 AI reviewer，而是一個 orchestrator 同時 dispatch 多組獨立的 model-and-harness pairing 去審查同一支 PR。
2. 每個 subagent 各自帶著自己的 context-retrieval、prompting、output-filtering 邏輯，彼此不知道對方的存在，獨立產出 review，不是同一模型跑兩輪取交集。
3. 多組獨立跑的理由：單一模型與 harness 組合帶著訓練資料裡的固有偏見，會產生一致的盲點；不同的 pairing 帶來不同的訓練背景、架構、推理風格，是為了 precision/recall 的互補取捨而非重複覆蓋。
4. 收斂機制：兩個獨立模型抓到同一個 code pattern，這個重疊本身就是高信心訊號；只有一組模型抓到的發現，會被丟回第一個模型做驗證，再進入過濾。
5. 過濾機制會壓掉純裝飾性、已經在後續 commit 被處理、或跟 repo 既有慣例不合的建議。
6. 客製化框架分三層：organization/global 規則、repository 規則，加上整合進 orchestration 層的 Custom Rules subagent，理由是單一規則檔案無法同時涵蓋組織政策、repo 架構慣例與情境判斷。
7. 系統在一個典型週產出 63.9% 的建議採用率、99.1% 的任務完成率，而採用率的量測方法本身只根據 1727 PRs / 5230 則抽樣留言算出，只有 90.1% 屬於高信心判斷——量測也有它自己的不確定邊界。

perspective.mechanism: 多組獨立的 model/harness pairing 平行審查同一 PR，靠「重疊即高信心、單一發現回頭驗證」的邏輯做去重與交叉驗證，外加三層規則框架把組織／repo／情境知識注入審查標準。
perspective.tradeoff: 平行跑多組模型的算力與延遲成本，換取單一模型固有偏見／盲點的緩解；量測方法本身的信心水準（90.1%）也是需要揭露的限制，63.9% 的採用率不是對全量建議都能百分之百溯源。
perspective.reader_use: 評估要不要導入類似系統的團隊，可以參考「不要押寶單一模型、規則要分層」這兩個設計決策，並且知道自己在量測成效時也會遇到同樣的『多少樣本有清楚證據』的邊界問題。

notes.quote: runs multiple review subagents in parallel, gathers their findings, deduplicates and cross-validates them
notes.interpretation: orchestrator 架構的核心描述：平行派工、收集、去重、交叉驗證是四個明確步驟。

notes.quote: a distinct model-and-harness pairing wrapped in its own context-retrieval, prompting, and output-filtering logic
notes.interpretation: 定義了 subagent 的組成：模型本身＋context-retrieval＋prompting＋output-filtering 是各自獨立的一整套。

notes.quote: The subagents review the PR independently without seeing other subagents' outputs.
notes.interpretation: 確認 subagent 之間互相不可見，是真正平行、非交集式的獨立審查。

notes.quote: a single AI model and harness carries inherent biases from its training data, leading to consistent blind spots
notes.interpretation: 多模型架構的核心理由：單一模型的盲點是系統性、可預期的，不會因為多跑幾次而改善。

notes.quote: Different pairings bring different training backgrounds, architectures, and reasoning styles, chosen for complementary trade-offs between precision and recall rather than redundant overlap.
notes.interpretation: 挑選多組 pairing 時的設計原則：互補而非重複，precision/recall 取捨要不同。

notes.quote: When two independently reasoning models flag the same code pattern, that convergence carries information.
notes.interpretation: 去重與交叉驗證的核心邏輯：重疊本身被當成一個判斷依據（高信心訊號）。

notes.quote: passed back to the first model for verification
notes.interpretation: 單一模型的發現不會直接放行或丟棄，而是回頭讓原模型再驗證一次，通過才進入最終輸出。

notes.quote: suggestions that are cosmetic, already addressed in a subsequent commit, or inconsistent with the repo's established patterns
notes.interpretation: 交叉驗證同時做過濾：裝飾性建議、已被後續 commit 處理的問題、跟 repo 既有慣例衝突的意見都會被擋下。
建議整體採用率的數字，來源沒有額外的 hedge 用語，直接陳述。
任務完成率的數字，來源標明是 for a typical week reviewing 79,000+ reviews across 40,000+ PRs 的規模下的數字，屬於一個典型週的觀察，非全歷史平均的明確宣稱。
一個典型週的審查規模數字。

notes.quote: 1727 PRs and 5230 rigorously sampled comments for a 7-day window
notes.interpretation: 採用率量測方法所根據的樣本規模，是一個 7 天窗口內的抽樣子集，不是全量統計。

notes.quote: 90.1% high-confidence evaluation rate validates both our methodology and the quality of suggestions themselves
notes.interpretation: 採用率量測方法本身的信心水準：只有九成的判斷有清楚證據支持，代表量測方法自己承認一成的盲區，63.9% 是在可判定樣本內算出來的。

notes.quote: no model, no matter how capable, can replace the encoded knowledge of your team's specific codebase
notes.interpretation: 客製化框架存在的理由：模型的判斷能力跟團隊特有的知識是兩件事。

notes.quote: a single rule file can't encode organization-wide policy or repository-level architectural rules, nor can it use case-specific guidance independently
notes.interpretation: 三層規則框架的直接理由：單一規則檔案無法同時涵蓋三種不同範圍的規則。

notes.quote: Global/Organization-level rules, Repository-level rules, Custom Rules subagent integrated into the orchestration layer
notes.interpretation: 三層客製化框架的具體命名：全域/組織層級規則、repository 層級規則、整合進 orchestration 層的 Custom Rules subagent。
多數審查的端到端完成時間上限。

notes.quote: PR events queued in under 5 seconds; review starts within ~90 seconds
notes.interpretation: 運作速度的兩個時間刻度：排入佇列與審查啟動的延遲上限。

notes.quote: Each worker host can review up to 12 PRs concurrently
notes.interpretation: 單一 worker host 的併發審查上限，來源沒有說明背後的資源瓶頸是什麼。

claims.claim_text: 只有兩組以上不約而同抓到同一段程式碼，系統才會留下這個建議 (original opener)
claims.evidence: A unique issue raised by only one model isn't discarded by default; it's first verified to confirm it's valid, then rated separately for importance.
claims.note: Opener's exclusivity contradicted the source AND the post's own body (which correctly states solo findings are verified, not discarded). Corrected: opener rewritten to '兩組以上不約而同抓到同一段程式碼，直接算高信心；只有一組抓到，也不會被丟掉，而是回頭再驗證一次。'

claims.claim_text: 一個典型的一週裡，這套系統審了 79,000 多次、涵蓋 40,000 多支 PR，任務完成率 99.1%，建議整體採用率 63.9%
claims.evidence: In a typical week it completes 79,000+ reviews across 40,000+ PRs... at a 99.1% task completion rate | 63.9% combined acceptance rate
claims.note: All four figures confirmed.

claims.evidence: This high-confidence share is what makes the 63.9% acceptance rate trustworthy...
claims.note: Confirmed after targeted re-fetch of the evaluation sections.

claims.claim_text: 同樣是七天的窗口，5,230 則留言是從 79,000 多次審查中抽樣出來、拿去人工判定的子集
claims.evidence: In a typical week it completes 79,000+ reviews... | 1727 PRs and 5230 rigorously sampled comments for a 7-day window
claims.note: Source never states the two windows are the same week, nor that 5,230 was sampled FROM the 79,000, nor that judging was human. Corrected: removed the unsupported same-window/sampled-from/human-judgment linkage; now states the 1727/5230 sample as independently drawn, without asserting the relationship to the 79,000 figure.

claims.claim_text: 抽樣判斷裡只有 90.1% 屬於 high-confidence evaluation，比例是九成
claims.evidence: 4711 (90.1%) received a High confidence rating, 450 (8.6%) were rated Medium, and 69 (1.3%) were rated Low.
claims.note: Confirmed, including the post's gloss of what 'confidence' measures.

claims.claim_text: 剩下一成的判斷沒有足夠證據支持，算不進採用率的分子或分母
claims.evidence: 4711 (90.1%) received a High confidence rating, 450 (8.6%) were rated Medium, and 69 (1.3%) were rated Low.
claims.note: Source never says Medium/Low-confidence judgments were excluded from the acceptance-rate calculation — only that confidence levels were assigned. Corrected: replaced the flat exclusion claim with the verified fact that ~10% fall in Medium/Low confidence, without asserting how (or whether) they're excluded from the calculation.

claims.claim_text: 「90.1% high-confidence evaluation rate validates both our methodology and the quality of suggestions themselves」
claims.evidence: The 90.1% high-confidence evaluation rate validates both our methodology and the quality of suggestions themselves.
claims.note: Verbatim; post reads it more skeptically than the source intends, explicitly flagged as the author's own inversion — deflated, not an error.

claims.claim_text: 讓自動建議在幾分鐘內就能帶著可解釋的信心分數，送到人類手上 (original closer + 'able to be defined, measurable confidence score' at H2 2)
claims.evidence: most reviews complete end-to-end in under 10 minutes
claims.note: '可解釋的信心分數' (an explainable confidence score delivered to humans) is not supported — the source describes overlap-as-signal internally, not a score surfaced to reviewers. Corrected both occurrences: closer now reads '較高的可信度' instead of '可解釋的信心分數'; H2 2's related sentence now reads '「重疊」這個可以外部驗證的訊號' instead of 'can be clearly defined, measurable confidence score'.
